description: outgoing_query_info returns the caller's own dict when no guard applies; internal and outgoing query shapes are both plain dicts, so the outgoing-only invariant rests on convention.
has_rewriting_guard mirrors factory.py wiring conditions rather than asking which guards were wired; the Markdown and metadata labels are decided at two call sites.

outgoing_query_info returns the caller's own query_info dict unchanged when as_written is false or sql is empty; internal and outgoing values are both plain dicts, so the outgoing-only note-line/as_written invariant rests on convention.

has_rewriting_guard re-derives the factory's wiring conditions instead of asking which guards build_agent wired; the Markdown label (query_database.py:940) and metadata label (server.py:522) are decided at two call sites and can drift if a guard is added.
